title: Teller refuses on camera to discuss Lazar
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Teller refuses on camera to discuss Lazar, about after 1989 at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean, I spoke to the guy before he went and interviewed Teller. He was one of Teller's students.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, interviewed by podcast host Jesse Michels, tells of a moment around 1989 when a scientist, Edward Teller, was asked about Lazar on camera and refused to talk about him. Lazar says he spoke beforehand to the man who did that interview, a former student of Teller's, and he raises it because a refusal from Teller would hint that Lazar's claims touched something real.
